evals.name: mid-task-handoff
evals.prompt: I need to stop now, write a handoff so tomorrow we continue from here.
evals.expected_output: Gathers git facts (branch, ahead/behind, uncommitted files, stash), writes the handoff in the template with evidence for done items, exact next steps and open questions, to docs.plan or .agents/handoffs/, captures session lessons, and tells the user where it is.
expectations: Includes the branch and uncommitted-file state from git, not from memory
Next steps are concrete and ordered
States where the handoff was written
